scripts.lint: turbo run lint && eslint eslint.config.js scripts && prettier --check .
scripts.test:changed: turbo run build --filter="./packages/*" && pnpm -r --filter "...[origin/main]" --filter "!sodiq-platform" run test:changed
scripts.test:e2e: turbo run build --filter=@sodiq/api --filter=@sodiq/web^... && pnpm --filter @sodiq/api e2e:build && pnpm --filter @sodiq/web test:e2e
scripts.sync: git switch main && git pull --ff-only && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm db:migrate
scripts.api:client: turbo run build --filter=@sodiq/api && pnpm --filter @sodiq/api openapi && pnpm --filter @sodiq/web api:types
